narrativeProgression.description: The man states that 'momentum is equal to the mass times the velocity,' introducing the central concept of the video.
The man claims that 'light is not moving,' marking a shift in his theory and sparking further discussion.
The man suggests that 'the longer the wavelength, the slower it's replicated,' connecting replication to a measurable property of light.
